newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch population edges up in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Dutch population edges up in 1996.

text.p: The Netherlands, already Europe's most densely populated country, saw its population edge up further last year.
The officially registered population rose by about 68,000 people to 15,494,000, the Central Bureau of Statistics (CBS) said on Tuesday.
Local population registers showed that 109,000 immigrants arrived in the Netherlands while 66,000 people emigrated. Live births totalled 189,000 while 138,000 deaths were registered.

The CBS said this resulted in a net gain in the population of 94,000 but that this figure was revised down to 68,000 because 26,000 people included in local population registers no longer resided in the town or village in question.
